episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After betrayal leaves Meri broke and homeless, she asks stranger Kim Wooju - who shares her ex's name - to pose as her husband for a luxury townhouse.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Wooju refuses Meri but later agrees to be her husband. When Meri learns of the condition to get her prize, she seeks Wooju to reprise the role.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: After losing her home, Meri moves into a motel. Wooju's help backfires and their fake marriage faces new risks when neighbour Sanghyeon grows wary.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Meri and Wooju prepare for the department store president's visit, she opens her heart but family matters push Wooju to reveal the reason he helps.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Meri hides her ex's call, but facing Sanghyeon at work stirs tension. Wooju visits Meri but is shaken to learn their link as her ex circles closer.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: After a risky rooftop moment, Meri and Wooju grow closer. As her ex looms and a VVIP scandal erupts, they work together, bringing them even closer.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Wooju confesses his feelings, but Meri hesitates. As he shares his past to prove his sincerity, a stormy night at Beauté Palace changes everything.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Wooju opens up about his past, and Meri begins to understand him better. They grow closer under the starlight and start to imagine a future together. Wooju gains warmth from Meri's family, while Meri resolves to face truths she has avoided. Yet ambition and obsession cast shadows over their future.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Meri's ex threatens to expose her secret, forcing her to protect Wooju. Meanwhile, Wooju senses trouble at work and plans a date to cheer her up.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: At Myungsoondang's 80th anniversary event, Sanghyeon notices something between Wooju and Meri, but an unexpected ally comes to their aid. Meanwhile, Myungsoondang faces troubling rumors, and Wooju follows a suspicious lead that uncovers a major secret.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Wooju uncovers the 25-year-old truth to save Myungsoondang, facing the one behind it all. Meri turns to Sanghyeon as a scandal shakes Beauté Group.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Meri's ex publicly accuses her and Wooju, igniting a media frenzy as the Myungsoondang scandal peaks. Refusing to back down, they confront the chaos.
